correctness.rationale: I independently enumerated all 4096 subsets of the cube’s 12 graph edges using the degree<=2 predicate; 1698 nonempty faces, dimensions0..7 have exact counts (12,66,212,423,516,352,108,9), matching the forbidden full-degree-three star characterization. The specified staged greedy matching produced 846 disjoint pairs with stage counts (665,94,8,51,8,10,7,0,2,1,0,0), leaving one vertex (mask1), a four-cell (598), four five-cells (888,1446,2710,3158). A full 1698-face/7980-incidence Hasse DAG sort confirmed acyclicity. Independent signed oriented gradient elimination gave exact integer row (-1,1,-1,-1) from the four critical 5-cells to one 4-cell. Since pi4(S4)=Z and the row is primitive, an integral basis change cancels one 4/5 pair and makes other three attaching maps null, yielding ∨3 S5. Independent mod2 ranks (11,55,157,266,250,99,9) give reduced b5=3, but alone would not justify the integral wedge.
residual_risks: Exact finite checks do not generalize outside the claim domain.

value.rationale: The cube Q3 is a canonical minimal cubic hypercube. Degree cap2 is its one interesting relaxation between ordinary matchings (cap1) and the full edge simplex (cap3). The exact homotopy class contrasts M1(Q3)≈4 S2 with M2(Q3)≈3 S5, a meaningful natural invariant and benchmark for higher matching complexes, without claiming all hypercubes.
residual_risks: Motivated but scope-limited finding; not evidence of stronger generalization.
